intervention_description: Whole treated-incidence cohort of an early psychosis service; no allocation. Up to two years of comprehensive case management with assertive outreach.
First-generation migrants, i.e. young people born outside Australia; a post-hoc split of the one recruited cohort by country of birth.
Young people born in Australia, including second-generation migrants, whom the authors state could not be identified separately; a post-hoc split of the one recruited cohort by country of birth.
Whole recruited sample; all 53 completed the same prevocational training group before baseline. No allocation and no comparator.

Employed group (EG): the 19 participants who obtained any kind of paid work for at least 30 days during follow-up. Defined BY the outcome, so it is a post-hoc outcome-defined subgroup and can support no prevalence.
Usual vocational services enhanced by a half-day workshop for vocational specialists on cognitive impairment and job-relevant coping strategies, plus consultation calls every one to three months.

intervention_name: Thinking Skills for Work (TSW) plus Enhanced Vocational Rehabilitation
intervention_description: The same enhanced vocational services plus manualised cognitive remediation: about 24 hours of Cogpack computer exercises with strategy coaching and taught self-management strategies, delivered by a cognitive specialist integrated into the vocational team.

Manualised CBT-informed group programme targeting defeatist beliefs about work, four modules of two sessions, delivered weekly in groups of two to three alongside a four-month work therapy placement that both arms received.

Time-matched active control: weekly 45-minute participant-led support and discussion about work-related issues, with no curriculum and no personalised work feedback, alongside the same four-month work therapy placement.

Whole randomised RADAR cohort with both allocation groups combined, as the report itself does: 126 allocated to supported gradual antipsychotic dose reduction and discontinuation and 127 to maintenance antipsychotic treatment. The experimental intervention is a medication regimen, not an employment intervention.
Participants with at least one relapse of any severity during the 24-month trial. A POST-RANDOMISATION subgroup defined by an event occurring after allocation.
Participants with no relapse during the 24-month trial. A POST-RANDOMISATION subgroup defined by an event occurring after allocation.
